theme: An open day with a few October deadlines knocking.
greeting: Just one appointment on the books today, Dan, and a clear stretch after it. The real call on your attention is a cluster of mid-October booking deadlines and a governance invitation waiting on your reply.

needsAttention.title: Write back to Anne on the November OECD meeting
needsAttention.detail: Anne Molyneux emailed this morning asking you to join the OECD corporate governance meeting in November — she's heard you've left your firm and wants you in the room. A reply closes the loop while there's still runway before November.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Your own deadline to book the all-kids December trip is Oct 15 — two days out — and holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year. The shortlist needs to land so the booking can follow.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size Portland rental for Christmas week is the item most likely to bite — thin holiday inventory that sells out — and it's been open since mid-September. A refundable booking held now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Set the Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland-to-St Pete drive has to fall in the Oct 5–18 off-week gap, which closes this weekend. Picking the two dates lets the hotel night get booked.

flagged.title: LinkedIn reply owed to Abijah Kanene
flagged.detail: A corporate-affairs contact is waiting on your response in LinkedIn messages.

flagged.title: On-target role alerts this week
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced several public-policy and governance roles — Rockefeller Foundation, Aster, an SVP Global Public Policy posting.

inbox.noise: The rest is reading and offers — ICGN and WSJ policy briefs, the St Pete locals, and travel and retail promotions.

resolved.title: Proposal is out to Valoris Catalysts
resolved.detail: You sent the proposal to Mike Lubrano and the Valoris team this afternoon, following last week's conversation — now in their hands to consider.

resolved.title: Vinalhaven ferry tickets forwarded to Mike
resolved.detail: The Maine State Ferry confirmation arrived and you passed it to Mike yesterday.

recipe.why: Autumn brings chestnuts and winter squash to the market, both at their sweetest now.

Nothing else is scheduled — the hours are open ground.
The girls are with Jen this week, so the evening stays your own.
